title: Under Frequency the push error sits bottom centre, clear of the docks, and Start a Circle wears the kit's plus

source.ref: LIVE-938 area 6 (push error position, Start a Circle icon), Frequency design build handoff 2026-10-14

detail: Area 6 of LIVE-938, carved out so it ships on its own. The push save-failed note was fixed to the bottom-left corner, on top of the Frequency You dock on desktop and the tab bar on a phone. Under Frequency it now lands bottom centre, where the kit toast does, above the tab bar and rising with the open footer, on a kit surface. Start a Circle drew DAWN's lucide sparkle inside the kit's pastel pill. Under Frequency it now draws the kit plus, the same as New event. DAWN is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];if(!fs.readFileSync('components/push/registration.tsx','utf8').includes('fq-push-note fixed'))bad.push('push note has no Frequency hook');if(!/\.fq-push-note\{left:50%/.test(fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css','utf8')))bad.push('push note is not centred');if(!/SITE_DESIGN === 'frequency' \? <FqIcon name=\"plus\"/.test(fs.readFileSync('components/compose/new-circle-compose.tsx','utf8')))bad.push('Start a Circle has no kit plus');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1100: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the push note returns to the docks' corner or Start a Circle loses the kit plus. Behavior is push-note-position.test.tsx.
